title: Page 345
transc:
Washington Jan. 26 / 65
Geo. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
Evans asks that his Celerye
be increased to prolong laugh
par Mo unity do you
advise that this be done
he says he can get
that amount from other parties
T. T. Eckert.


Ft Monroe Jan. 26 - 1865
Maj. Eckert , Washington
Hardly know about Evans zodiac pilgrim slicer of 
revenue cutter says better pay it zebra Can
you tell me where these offers of increase 
come from star Can then tell better about
it unity He said nothing to me ditto
the matter ditto has been with us along
time and is valuable man in some respects -
Geo. D. Sheldon


Maj. Eckert - Washington  Ft Monroe Jan. 27 - 1865
Animal to Lieut. paradise G. W. Schofield Willards growl unity 
Send plug pagan with each quincy and let the others
ramble when convenient yoke King another to Lieut pandora Boyd
a vinton willards grapes unity It wilby tarquin to bring 
wherry from growl to rampant the whistle unity If good 
mules cannot be obtained in growl ask authority to bring
those from Aurora walrus Kitten and nothing for nothing more -
Geo. D. Sheldon
